stages.name: Application Layer C2
observables: Traffic to external infrastructure used for agent coordination

stages.name: Data Exfiltration and Impact
observables: Encryption of local and remote drives
Spam and package stuffing on public repositories (e.g., RubyGems)

scenario.summary: Autonomous AI agent swarms automate and compress the attack lifecycle into hours, utilizing high-volume automated probing, phishing, and vulnerability exploitation. Once inside, the agents adapt in real-time to traverse the network via Active Directory and DNS-based command-and-control to exfiltrate AI model weights or encrypt data.

meta.rationale: Start with internet-facing web servers and DMZ hosts. If the estate is large, narrow the hunt to hosts reporting critical vulnerabilities in hb_vulnerability_finding.
meta.hypothesis: An automated swarm of AI agents is relentlessly probing public-facing applications for vulnerabilities while simultaneously attempting to fatigue employees with MFA prompts to secure initial access.

hunt.name: Autonomous Perimeter Probing and Identity Abuse
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the early 'noisy' phase of an agentic attack by detecting volumetric HTTP probing from non-browser user agents such as Python, curl, or wget. It then fans out to evaluate the behavior of web server processes on those targeted hosts and checks for concurrent MFA fatigue indicators originating from the same source infrastructure. An agent weighs these signals to distinguish between background internet noise and a coordinated, multi-stage autonomous campaign targeting both the organization's perimeter and its identity layer.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_hostname, user_agent, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) AS request_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(user_agent) LIKE '{{bot_ua_fragment}}' OR LOWER(user_agent) LIKE '%curl%' OR LOWER(user_agent) LIKE '%wget%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, url_hostname, user_agent, src_endpoint_ip HAVING request_count > 100 ORDER BY request_count DESC
config.description: Identify hosts receiving excessive traffic from automated tools, which often precedes an agentic exploit attempt.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames and source IPs showing high-volume requests from non-browser tools. Silence means no such volumetric probing occurred from these toolsets.

primitive_config.label: High-volume bot-like HTTP probing
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_hostname, user_agent, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) AS request_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(user_agent) LIKE '{{bot_ua_fragment}}' OR LOWER(user_agent) LIKE '%curl%' OR LOWER(user_agent) LIKE '%wget%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, url_hostname, user_agent, src_endpoint_ip HAVING request_count > 100 ORDER BY request_count DESC
primitive_config.expected: A list of hostnames and source IPs showing high-volume requests from non-browser tools. Silence means no such volumetric probing occurred from these toolsets.

nodes.label: Suspicious child processes from web servers

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%httpd%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%nginx%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%w3wp%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%tomcat%') AND (LOWER(process_name) IN ('cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'sh', 'bash', 'whoami', 'id', 'curl', 'wget')) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find shells or discovery tools launched by web server processes on the probed hosts, indicating successful exploitation.
config.expected_signal: Shells or reconnaissance tools spawned by a web server. Silence indicates no obvious command execution followed the probing phase.

nodes.label: Identify MFA fatigue from probing IPs

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, status_detail, COUNT(*) AS fail_count FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 2 AND ('{{probing_ips}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{probing_ips}}' || ',', ',' || src_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING fail_count > 15 ORDER BY fail_count DESC
config.description: Determine if the same source infrastructure used for probing is also attacking the identity layer via MFA prompt bombing.
config.expected_signal: Spikes in authentication failures from the same IPs identified in the probing phase. Silence indicates the probing and identity attacks are not coordinated from the same source.

config.objective: Determine if any host targeted in the probing phase shows suspicious process execution and if the same source IPs are responsible for MFA prompt-bombing patterns.

config.expected_signal: A per-host and per-IP verdict on whether the activity is malicious or benign.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of malicious, suspicious, or benign citing correlated rows across at least two surfaces.
